title: Warriors' Draymond Green Reacts To Ronnie 2K Trolling Klay Thompson On Social Media
htmlContent:
The Warriors have only played one pre-season game, and Steph Curry is already back in his bag of tricks.

Join forces with Splash Brother Klay Thompson in a 3-point contest at NBA Japan Games 2022; Curry made his first four triples in the first on his first basketball rack.

He's got something special for the money ball. Curry moved his wrist, and before the basketball spiraled into the net, he turned and looked at the fans behind him. Swished it.

After taking care of his teammates Jordan Poole and Moses Moody, Thompson sent a message to Ronnie 2K and 2K Sports.

“Ronnie 2K, change my three-point rating right now,” Klay Thompson said.

Ronnie then shared the footage with a caption, "#RentFree."

Draymond Green has always been known to defend his teammates, and he kept that narrative alive on Saturday.

“Ronnie, you promote a video game sir,” Green said on Twitter. “Stop acting like the old media.”

However, Ronnie 2K was not going to let Green have the final say.

“Sorry I don’t have a “stimulating” podcast to put this on this morning busy promoting a video game,” He replied on Twitter.

Klay Thompson took issue with his 88 overall three-point rating in NBA 2k23. Thompson is widely considered one of the best long-term threats ever. Nonetheless, he is tied for the second-highest score in NBA 2K23. Meanwhile, Stephen Curry is ranked first as a 99 overall three-point shooter.
